paragraphs: The M4 CS sits above the standard M4 Competition in the F82-generation M4 range, offering a more focused, track-oriented package. All M4 CS models use the S55 — a 3.0-litre twin-turbo inline-six petrol engine, essentially a development of the N55 with a closed-deck block, forged internals and higher boost. The S55 has a well-documented crank hub wear pattern, which is why every S55 rebuild we carry out includes a preventative crank hub upgrade as standard alongside the timing chain, bearings and gaskets. The M4 CS is no longer in production, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road.
